Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ORIGINAL six-character model sheet for a cozy Korean medieval village comedy game. Create ONE wide landscape 3:2 image, six full-body characters standing side by side on the same ground line, all clearly separated, no overlaps, all feet and hairstyles visible. Plain warm ivory background, no scenery, no frame, NO LETTERS, NO LABELS, no speech bubbles, no logos. The two supplied building pictures are STYLE references only: match their warm hand-painted storybook rendering, softly textured brushwork, grounded rustic detail, warm light, clear silhouettes. NOT pixel art, NOT anime, NOT flat vector, NOT glossy 3D. Gentle observational comedy, original faces, no existing fictional characters.
LEFT TO RIGHT, exactly SIX figures:
1. Newly appointed village chief, about 25, slim average height, short chestnut-brown CURLY hair, freshly made moss-green vest over loose ivory-white linen shirt, tan trousers, simple brown boots, baffled innocent expression. No beard or hat.
2. Marta, SHORT ROUND elderly grandmother, silver-white hair in a tidy round bun, kind round face and only a faint amber-orange glint in her eyes, cream blouse, muted plum skirt, pale cream apron patterned with small orange and pink flowers, sensible brown shoes. Hands gently folded. No wizard costume.
3. Gunter, TALL THIN middle-aged man, long shaggy gray bangs completely covering his eyes, thin long face, worn brown leather vest over dusty beige shirt, dark practical trousers, plain woodcutter axe on his back. Reserved posture. No armor or sword.

5. Pino, slim merchant around 30, BLACK CURLY hair, lively narrow face, LONG FOREST-GREEN SCARF, ocher-brown traveling coat, laden large backpack with pots, ropes and small bundles hanging from it. Charming innocent smile.
6. Barg, bulky intimidating middle-aged tavern keeper, dark burgundy headscarf, broad stern face, dark rolled-sleeve shirt and worn tan apron. Two very subtle horn-shaped bumps underneath his headscarf, no visible giant demon horns. Sturdy boots.
Make distinct stable faces and outfit silhouettes suitable for reuse in 10 story scenes. Express personalities with natural poses, not cartoon motion lines. Keep the entire lineup large within the page and preserve realistic relative heights.

For this earlier episode ONLY, he wears a neat medieval JUNIOR CIVIL SERVANT UNIFORM: restrained moss-green tailored long waistcoat/jacket with small brass buttons over an ivory collared shirt, brown belt and tan trousers. Preserve his established face and hair exactly, NOT Pino's black curls. Reference 2 is the existing episode illustration: match its warm detailed painted storybook gouache/watercolor brushwork, natural textures, soft golden lighting and gentle expressive character design. No pixel art, no glossy 3D, no flat vector.
SCENE: A medieval royal administration hall on assignment-lottery day, warm high arched windows, honey-colored wooden desks, stacks of parchment documents, restrained blue-and-gold kingdom banners with simple decorative motifs and NO writing. A LARGE rustic wooden lottery box with a narrow slot occupies the center desk. Immediately behind/beside it stands the protagonist at the visual center, holding an UNFOLDED SMALL LOTTERY SLIP at chest height with both hands. His face is frozen in stunned, pitiful disbelief: raised worried brows, wide eyes and stiff tiny mouth, shoulders rigid. Quietly funny and sympathetic, not exaggerated panic.
Behind him, exactly FOUR distinct original young fellow recruits in similar restrained clerk uniforms stand close together, hands partly covering mouths as they whisper, exchanging concerned and awkwardly amused looks. They must NOT resemble the five canonical village residents. On the protagonist's right stands a distinct middle-aged official with a tidy moustache (not a beard), receding dark hair and a muted blue-gray bureaucrat's coat. With a pitying awkward half-smile he pats the protagonist's shoulder; hand clearly rests on that shoulder.
A larger cream appointment document is tucked under the protagonist's upper arm at his side, BACK FACING VIEWER. One exposed rear corner has a tiny ink signature-like looping FLOURISH, completely illegible, a subtle hidden recommendation clue. Do not write any actual name, word or alphabet. The lottery slip has its unreadable side facing the viewer; no readable writing anywhere.
COMPOSITION CRITICAL: all faces, hands, lottery slip, document's signature corner and the lottery-box slot stay clearly inside the UPPER THREE QUARTERS (y<73%). Lower quarter is only quiet foreground desk front, floor and soft ambient shadows, safe for dialogue overlay, NO important information there. Eye-level medium-wide narrative framing with a little view of desktop, full head clearance. Entire scene fills canvas, no frame or dialogue panel. Balanced warm cream stone, ochre wood, moss green, muted blue and burgundy accents.
AVOID: readable letters, numbers, labels, speech balloons, captions, logos, watermarks, manga motion lines, supernatural effects, duplicates of protagonist, recognizable existing franchise characters. Six people total: protagonist, official, four recruits.
